text: For their minds plot violence, And their lips talk of trouble [for the innocent].
And by knowledge its rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.
For by wise guidance you can wage your war, And in an abundance of [wise] counselors there is victory and safety.
Wisdom is too exalted for a [hardened, arrogant] fool; He does not open his mouth in the gate [where the city's rulers sit in judgment].
The devising of folly is sin, And the scoffer is repulsive to men.
If you are slack (careless) in the day of distress, Your strength is limited.

If you [claim ignorance and] say, "See, we did not know this," Does He not consider it who weighs and examines the hearts and their motives? And does He not know it who guards your life and keeps your soul? And will He not repay [you and] every man according to his works?
Know that [skillful and godly] wisdom is [so very good] for your life and soul; If you find wisdom, then there will be a future and a reward, And your hope and expectation will not be cut off.
For a righteous man falls seven times, and rises again, But the wicked stumble in time of disaster and collapse.
Or the LORD will see your gloating and be displeased, And turn His anger away from your enemy.
For there will be no future for the evil man; The lamp of the wicked will be put out.
For their tragedy will rise suddenly, And who knows the punishment that both [the LORD and the king] will bring on the rebellious?
He kisses the lips [and wins the hearts of people] Who gives a right and straightforward answer.
Prepare your work outside And get it ready for yourself in the field; Afterward build your house and establish a home.
Do not say, "I will do to him as he has done to me; I will pay the man back for his deed."
Then your poverty will come as a robber, And your want like an armed man.
